title: Reject unrecognized flags in atelier-axi commands (AXI principle 6)
description: Commands parse args with args.includes()/flagValue() so a typo'd flag is silently ignored instead of failing loudly. AXI principle 6 requires failing on unrecognized flags. Safety edge: 'share --pasword x' silently publishes a PUBLIC page when the user meant private. Add a shared assertKnownFlags(args, allowed) helper and wire it into each command's arg parsing.

Clean break (no aliases). Leave frozen historical records (CHANGELOG, evidence, docs) untouched. App must pass pnpm run check.

title: Truncate dom_snapshot in poll output with --full escape hatch (AXI principle 3)
description: Poll output returns dom_snapshot verbatim and un-truncated (cli.js), plus prompt text. AXI principle 3 requires truncating large text with a size hint and a --full flag to bypass. Add default truncation of dom_snapshot with a byte-size hint, and a poll --full flag that returns the full snapshot.

title: Weave TDD + engineering principles + treehouse worktrees into the planner
description: Adjust the lavish feature planner workflow per user direction. (1) Enforce TDD rigor (Iron Law: no production code without a failing test first; RED -> watch it fail -> GREEN minimal -> verify -> REFACTOR; exceptions for prototypes/generated/config need user OK) authored fresh (no dependency on vendored .agents skills). (2) Weave four principles into lavish-plan + lavish-implement: TDD-first, systematic-over-ad-hoc, complexity-reduction, evidence-over-claims. (3) When implementation begins, acquire an isolated dev worktree via 'treehouse get --lease' (fallback: git worktree add, then feature branch) so work happens on a branch first for parallel dev; return it when done. (4) Commit durable records before the implement hand-off so a fresh worktree has plan.md. Portability: graceful degradation when treehouse absent. Keep pnpm run check green.
close_reason: Implemented TDD Iron Law + 4 engineering principles + treehouse dev-worktree flow (fallback git worktree/branch) + commit-records-before-handoff across lavish-plan, lavish-implement, plan-template; test-first packaging anchors. Commit 2069017. pnpm run check exit 0.

(2) Add a 'Decisions resolved during review' section to plan-template.md so small-route decisions survive without review.html. (3) Bake layout-safety guards into the decision-card template + design_rules note (overflow-x, min-width:0). (4) Add structural regression test for the decision-card template in test/cli-output.test.js. (5) Rename durable output root docs/atelier-plans -> docs/plans for portability across spec/skill/plan/prompt. (6) Reconcile SKILL.md Phase 1 (still says 'terminal interview, one question at a time') with the new 'surface questions in the UI' operating rule.
close_reason: Implemented all 5 review recommendations + the structural test; small-route reconciliation and check-green cleanup committed. #1/#3 (decision-card key + layout guards) landed via the playbook; #2/#4/#5 in commits 06e4405 + 1a6079c. pnpm run check exit 0, 457 tests.
